title: Growth + Handoff 1:1 prep (Diego)
content:
Context
- Weekly 1:1 with my manager; main goals this week: align on handoff of KV-cache tuning work to Platform SRE, discuss stretch growth goal (ownership of inference batching playbook), and surface any product risks before next sprint.
- Sprint ends Mar 19; hard cutover for public cluster config change targeted Mar 22 (coord with infra).
- Flags: PR #987 has a perf regression on long-sequence latencies in internal perf tests (see linked PR + Confluence notes). I own next steps but need manager support for cross-team prioritization.

Pre-read (send 24h before)
- Short summary (1 paragraph) of current status + ask (this doc)
- Key links: ENG-4321, PR#987, Confluence kv-cache notes

Timebox (30 min)
- 0–5 min: quick sync / personal check-in
- 5–12 min: handoff plan for KV-cache tuning + who does what
- 12–22 min: career stretch goal (batching playbook) — ask for scope, mentorship, and visibility
- 22–28 min: blockers/risks + immediate asks from manager
- 28–30 min: confirm next steps and owners

Handoff plan (aim is to go from my single-owner work to a maintainable SRE-owned config)
- What I’ve done: prototype dynamic prefix caching (local experiment harness), config suggestions for autoscaler thresholds, and a set of perf tests that reproduce regression on long sequences.
- What needs to transfer: test harness (how to run), checklist for rollback, runbook for config change, and a PR review sweep.
- Proposed owners: SRE lead (Ravi) owns rollout, I’ll be primary on-call for first 48 hours, SRE takes over monitoring alerts.
- Request for manager: a short sync between me + Ravi + manager to set SLA for monitoring and to authorize weekend slot if needed.

Career/stretch ask (framed as experiment)
- Goal: lead a "batching playbook" to codify best batching/cache/quantization knobs for 3 customer archetypes (low-latency, cost-sensitive, high-throughput).
- What I want: 1) runway (1.5 sprint allocation), 2) a mentor (suggest Evelyn), 3) a visible deliverable (internal doc + 2-hour brown bag + checklist for Optimize team).
- Why now: this ties to Optimize roadmap and reduces repeated ad-hoc batching decisions. Also positions me for IC4 expectations (cross-team deliverable).
- Ask to manager: feedback on scope (ok to prototype across two models) and agreement to sponsor a 2-week pilot with 1 customer demo.

Blockers / things I need from manager
- Prioritization: an ask to deprioritize two low-impact infra requests that are blocking my time (ticket IDs included in pre-read).
- Escalation: help getting a second SRE reviewer for PR#987 to unblock merge.
- Headroom: approval for 1.5 sprint allocation for batching playbook pilot (explicit permission to reallocate time).

Sensitive phrasing suggestions (use short, factual statements)
- If pushing for runway: "I can take this to a pilot in one sprint if I get 1.5 sprint-equivalents of focused time and a reviewer assigned."
- If asking to deprioritize: "These two tickets (links) consume X% of my time and have marginal product impact; deprioritizing them would let me deliver the playbook pilot which has higher cross-org leverage."

Desired outcomes from this 1:1 (explicit)
- Manager approves the brief sync with SRE to confirm rollout owners and monitoring SLAs.
- Manager agrees to sponsor my batching playbook pilot and assign a mentor.
- Manager helps escalate PR#987 review so we can merge before the sprint ends.

Notes to self (things to say / avoid)
- Say: concrete asks, measurements (how much time saved, expected latency improvement range), who covers risk.
- Avoid: framing this as "I have to do everything" — instead, show handoff and shared ownership.

Risks I should mention
- If SRE does not commit to runbook, rollout will be delayed and we may miss Mar 22 config window.
- Perf regression on PR#987 could show up to +10–15% p99 on long sequences; call this out as experimental number, not a fixed claim.

Follow-up plan after 1:1
- Send summary email with explicit owners and due dates (within 24h).
- Create a shared checklist in the PR and tag SRE reviewers.
- Draft the playbook one-pager and request feedback from Evelyn + Product.

Quick checklist for meeting prep (before sending pre-read)
- [ ] Short paragraph summary + ask written (include dates and PR links)
- [ ] Confirm Evelyn and Ravi are ok to be cc'd
- [ ] Add one concrete metric expectation for playbook pilot (e.g., reduce per-token cost by 8–12% for batch scenario)
- [ ] Attach perf test commands + how-to-run (link to PR test harness)

Draft closing line for email / pre-read:
"Hi — quick 10–12 line pre-read below. Primary asks: 1) help escalate review & confirm SRE rollout owner for KV-cache config, 2) sponsor a 1-sprint pilot for a batching playbook I’ll own. Happy to walk through during the 1:1. — Diego"
action_items: Schedule 15-min kickoff with Ravi + manager (owner: Diego) — target Mar 13
Tag SRE reviewers on PR#987 and request review by Mar 15 (owner: Diego)
Create playbook one-pager draft and share with Evelyn for mentorship (owner: Diego) — draft by Mar 19
Send post-1:1 summary email with owners and dates (owner: Diego) — within 24h after meeting
Add rollback checklist to PR and create monitoring dashboard stub (owner: Ravi) — done before Mar 22
